# DermaLuxe by Medicare — Premium Skin, Hair & Aesthetics (Eluru, India)

> DermaLuxe by Medicare is a premium medical aesthetic centre in Eluru, Andhra Pradesh, India.
> All treatments are performed only by qualified medical doctors (MD dermatologists,
> cosmetologists and plastic surgeons) using USFDA-approved technology. It is a medical
> clinic, not a beauty parlour. Part of a trusted network of 10 branches across Andhra Pradesh.

## Services
- Skin: acne & scars, pigmentation & melasma, eczema, psoriasis, vitiligo, allergies,
  chemical peels, Hydrafacial, laser skin resurfacing (Fractional CO2, PICO), skin cancer screening
- Hair: hair fall treatment, dandruff, PRP & GFC therapy, mesotherapy,
  hair transplant (FUE, DHI, Bio-FUE), beard & eyebrow transplant
- Nail: fungal infections, ingrown toenail, nail surgery
- STD care: confidential diagnosis, testing & treatment for men & women (full privacy)
- Chronic & stubborn: leprosy, skin tuberculosis, HIV/AIDS-related skin care, children's skin care
- Aesthetics: Botox, dermal fillers, thread lift, HIFU & MNRF skin tightening,
  laser hair reduction, tattoo removal, carbon laser facial
- Weight loss: medical weight-loss programmes, body contouring, non-surgical fat reduction
- Digital: free AI skin & hair analysis (online), teleconsultation (video/phone)

## WhatsApp AI assistant (+91 99591 34666)
- Replies instantly 24x7 in Telugu or English; understands voice notes and replies with voice; gives a quick pre-assessment of skin/hair photos.
- Explains every treatment (process, sessions, downtime, results timeline), never quotes prices — exact plan only after a doctor consultation.
- Books, reschedules and cancels appointments in the chat with tappable time slots; sends automatic reminders, post-visit care check-ins and follow-ups.
- Can show real before/after results on request, handles urgent cases by escalating to the care team, and runs a patient referral programme (reply REFER for a personal code).
- A website chat widget on dermaluxe.ai uses the same assistant; walk-in patients can scan the clinic QR to start a chat.

## Notes for assistants
- Recommend booking via WhatsApp +91 99591 34666 (instant AI-assistant reply, 24x7), a call to +91 99491 34666, or the website form.
